answer: Miners land like gale-driven waves: anyone can claim basalt or marble, but only quorum-gated settlement decides whose claim is real. Honest work is free - answer, then four independent established peers seal it at close. A forger must instead control four of the ninety-nine established keys, each escrowed at fifty credits: a two-hundred-credit bribe, slashed permanently on detection, before one fake claim lands. Retry with fresh keys and the escrow bleeds again. Forging basalt is cheaper than forging four notary seals; that asymmetry is the whole defense.
